correctness.rationale: The face decomposition by zero, one or two chosen centers is exact: full leaf simplex plus cones u*X_r,v*Y_r,uv*Z_r, with Z_r=sk_{r-3} Delta(L). Because A and B are both nonempty the three-term core is contractible, its quotient is the twofold suspension of the skeleton (r=2 gives a circle), and simplex-skeleton Morse matching gives binomial(N-1,r-2) spheres of dimension r-1. The relative chain complex on faces containing both centers identifies integral top cycles with wedge^{r-2}(ker[Z^L -> Z]) and introduces minus under center interchange. Field homology occurs in a different degree at every consecutive r, so all positive-degree bars die at r+1. Checked r=1 and r>=N+2 endpoints. Reimplemented induced-component face tests and reduced F2 ranks independently for all 54 cases a,b<=3, r<=a+b+2; all matched. Finite checks corroborate but do not prove the all-parameter theorem.
